# touch

Create missing empty files through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/touch new-file.txt

moonx cli/touch -c missing-file.txt
```

Create missing files in operand order. With -c, missing files are skipped without creation.

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-c`, `--no-create` | Skip missing files without creating them. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

Use `--help` for the complete option list.

## Notes

- Existing files fail even with -c: timestamp updates are unsupported.
- -a, -m, -d, -r, -t and --time are recognized but rejected before mutation. Earlier successful creates remain after later failures.

Build from source with the MoonBit 1.0 RC1 toolchain.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
